def predict_union(grid):
 from collections import Counter
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]; out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 for r,row in enumerate(grid):
  inds=[i for i,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
  if not inds: continue
  # only trailing-bg suffix
  cut=inds[-1]+1
  if cut>=w: continue
  best=[]
  for t,ref in enumerate(grid):
   if t==r: continue
   # find any matching run ending at/before cut-1 that can support suffix forecast
   for start in range(cut):
    if row[start]!=ref[start]: continue
    end=start
    while end+1<cut and row[end+1]==ref[end+1]: end+=1
    if end==cut-1 and all(x==bg for x in row[end+1:]):
     future=[c for c in range(cut,w) if ref[c]!=bg]
     if future: best.append((len(future),end-start+1,ref))
  if best:
   _,_,ref=max(best,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
   for c in range(cut,w):
    if ref[c]!=bg: out[r][c]=1
 return out
u=predict_union(grid)
print([(i,[j for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==1]) for i,r in enumerate(u) if 1 in r])
